text:
release-coordinator: Heads up — policy change for the nightly deploy window starting next week. Read below and ack if you own any night jobs/service rollouts.

release-coordinator: TL;DR: No non-critical merges between 00:00-04:00 PT. Nightly canaries will be limited to 0.5% for first 30m, then 5% if stable. Emergency rollback drill every Wednesday @ 02:15 PT for two weeks.

infra-oncall: ack. I'll update the ops schedule and notify infra rotation.

pj: how do we mark a deploy as "critical" during the freeze?

release-coordinator: Critical = security patch, data-loss fix, or SEV1 mitigation. Must file /freeze-except with owner, tests, and approvers (sec + oncall). Use label "night-critical".

anita: Any change to autoscaling or mem configs during night windows? Those are often part of infra patches.

release-coordinator: Those count as infra changes. If they're non-critical, schedule for daytime. For urgent infra that affects availability, follow /freeze-except.

qa-lead: FYI we'll move nightly regression job to run at 04:30 PT to avoid overlap. Will update dashboards.

release-bot: policy-update: Nightly window rule v1 posted to docs at https://intranet.redwood/policies/night-deploys. Rule ID: NDW-1. 

sec-team: Adding that security sweeps for OpenSSL/crypto libs must be done pre-deploy for night-critical items. We'll prioritize reviews during freeze.

release-coordinator: Rollout plan for rollout automation:
- Week 1: policy announcement (this week) + docs.
- Week 2: enforce rule in CI (block merges during window) and schedule first rollback drill.
- Week 3: enforce canary ramping in traffic router.

pj: Can we get an example rollback command for the drill? Want to rehearse locally.

infra-oncall: Sure. Example (staging rollback):
```
# trigger rollback to previous revision
./deployctl rollback --service=text-gen --env=staging --to-rev=prod-2026-03-20-21
# verify health
./deployctl check --service=text-gen --env=staging --timeout=300
```

anita: I'll run the drill with infra-oncall on Wednesday. ETA 02:10 to prep.

release-bot: scheduled-drill: NDW-1-DRILL-001 created for 2026-03-25T02:15:00PT. Participants: infra-oncall, anita, pj, qa-lead.

pj: Can we auto-notify owners if a rollback is triggered? Current alerts go to #ops but not owner paging.

release-coordinator: Good call. I'll add an alert rule: page owner on rollback + post to #ops and #eng-releases.

qa-lead: quick ask: will canary telemetry for night deploys be retained longer? We sometimes need more time to surface regressions.

release-coordinator: Yes — telemetry retention for night canaries extended from 2h to 8h for first 48h after rollout.

sec-team: Note: any night-critical deploy touching auth must include runtime assertion tests. We'll reject fast-tracked items without them.

release-coordinator: Action items summary (owners):
- infra: enforce CI block + alert paging (infra-oncall).
- docs: publish NDW-1 and example runbooks (release-coordinator).
- qa: reschedule nightly job (qa-lead).
- teams: ack or request exception by EOD.

pj: acked. Will flag our scheduled routing tweak for daytime.

anita: ack. Will join drill.

release-bot: preflight-checks for enforcement patch: 9/9 green. Merge window enforcement scheduled for 2026-03-27 00:00 PT.

release-coordinator: Thanks all. If you foresee blockers to the drill or enforcement, speak up now. Otherwise, I'll post a short summary to #general tomorrow morning. :mega:
